content.en: Oh! It’s you again! How’s the festival been? Having fun?
content.zh: 哎呀！又是你！在大会上玩得怎么样？开心吗？

content.en: It’s been pretty nice, haha. How’s business for you?
content.zh: 挺不错的哈哈，您生意怎样。

content.en: Hahaha, thanks for the good wishes. I’ve already lost count of how many people came to buy dolls today.
content.zh: 哈哈哈，接你吉言，今天来买玩偶的人我都数不过来了。

content.en: (The vendor is beaming with happiness, a sharp contrast to the atmosphere around him.)
content.zh: （摊贩洋溢着幸福的笑容，跟周围的气氛形成了鲜明的对比）
